title: login() accepts empty password and authenticates successfully
description: 在生产环境中发现用户可以传空字符串作为密码登录。login('alice', '') 返回 True，因为 user_store.get 能找到用户且空字符串 == 空字符串的比较可能绕过密码校验。这是一个严重的安全漏洞。
resolution: 在 login() 方法开头增加空用户名和空密码的显式校验：if not username or not password: return False。由 bob 在 commit d4f8b1c6 中修复。
author: diana

comments.author: alice
comments.text: This is critical. We need to fix this before the next release.

comments.author: bob
comments.text: I'll add a guard clause at the beginning of login(). The empty string comparison issue is Python-specific.

comments.author: diana
comments.text: Verified the fix works. Login with empty credentials now returns False.

title: Database connection timeout when service starts under load
description: 在生产部署时，当多个 worker 同时启动，DatabaseConnection.connect() 会超时。error 日志显示 socket.timeout，但没有重试逻辑。
resolution: 在 connect() 方法中加入 3 次重试逻辑，每次间隔 1 秒。同时将默认 timeout 从 5 秒增加到 15 秒。由 charlie 在 commit f6b0d3e8 中修复。
author: eve

comments.author: charlie
comments.text: Reproduced locally by simulating concurrent connections. The root cause is the default 5-second socket timeout being too aggressive.

comments.author: bob
comments.text: Should we also add connection pooling for this? Otherwise we keep creating new connections.

comments.author: charlie
comments.text: Good point. Let me fix the timeout first, and open a separate issue for pooling.

title: is_authenticated() throws KeyError when user dict missing keys
description: 如果传入 is_authenticated() 的 user dict 没有 'username' 或 'password' 键，函数抛出 KeyError 而非返回 False。这会导致整个请求失败。
resolution: 使用 dict.get() 替代直接键访问，给缺失键提供默认值 None。由 eve 在 commit b8d2f5a0 中修复。
author: alice

comments.author: eve
comments.text: This is a defensive programming issue. We should use .get() with defaults.

title: bootstrap() function has confusing variable naming
description: bootstrap() 中内联了 user_store 字典字面量，导致代码可读性差。变量命名也不够清晰。建议重构。
resolution: 提取 user_store 变量到独立赋值语句。将验证逻辑改为 early-return 模式，减少嵌套。
author: charlie

comments.author: diana
comments.text: Agreed. I'll extract user_store and use early return for the auth failure case.
